mapper.sql: id, org_id, title, status, severity, reportable, occurred_from, occurred_to, detected_at, customer_notified_at, ppc_reported_at, individuals_notified_at, summary, containment, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appi_incident (org_id, title, status, severity, reportable, occurred_from, occurred_to, detected_at, customer_notified_at, ppc_reported_at, individuals_notified_at, summary, containment, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{severity}, #{reportable}, #{occurredFrom}, #{occurredTo}, COALESCE(#{detectedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{customerNotifiedAt}, #{ppcReportedAt}, #{individualsNotifiedAt}, #{summary}, #{containment}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE appi_incident SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, severity = #{severity}, reportable = #{reportable}, occurred_from = #{occurredFrom}, occurred_to = #{occurredTo}, detected_at = COALESCE(#{detectedAt}, detected_at), customer_notified_at = #{customerNotifiedAt}, ppc_reported_at = #{ppcReportedAt}, individuals_notified_at = #{individualsNotifiedAt}, summary = #{summary}, containment = #{containment}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN w.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE al.workspace_id END AS workspaceId, w.name AS workspaceName, COALESCE(al.entity_type, 'system') AS entityType, al.action, al.outcome, COUNT(*) AS eventCount, MIN(al.created_at) AS firstSeenAt, MAX(al.created_at) AS lastSeenAt FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN workspace w ON w.id = al.workspace_id AND w.org_id = al.org_id WHERE al.org_id = #{orgId} AND al.created_at >= #{occurredFrom} AND al.created_at <= #{occurredTo} GROUP BY CASE WHEN w.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE al.workspace_id END, w.name, COALESCE(al.entity_type, 'system'), al.action, al.outcome ORDER BY eventCount DESC, lastSeenAt DESC, workspaceId, entityType, action, outcome LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
